concept: Tabs are pills on the pane; the selected one is filled and the content below rises into place as the choice settles.

list.why: pills sit in one row with a small gap, a set of objects of the same kind

trigger.why: each tab is a full-height pill with a ring, a touch target that shows its edge

content.why: the panel below belongs to the selected tab and is focusable for keyboard users

active.why: a press shrinks the control briefly and faster than hover, because a press is a reply to the reader

data-state=active.why: the selected tab is filled blue and loses its ring, a change of shape as well as colour

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo so the focused control is visible on any scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw borders and underline the selected tab so selection survives without colour

background-color.why: the selected fill eases in at hover pace

color.why: the label colour changes with the fill over the same duration

box-shadow.why: the ring fades out as the fill arrives so the two read as one change

transform.why: the press shrink uses transform so the row does not shift

@tab-in.why: the new panel rises half the entry distance and settles, the content arriving rather than appearing
